svg.title: K3 — Drum and belt line (overview)
svg.text: No food manipulator: a tilting, self-washing drum, a belt under two fixed gates and a vessel shuttle meet at one shaft.
vessel shuttle: deck + head on 2 masts
Pour about the lip into the pot
Belt: slice cucumber at the nose
Shuttle: bowl to hand-over port R3
1/9 Box docks above the shaft and tilts: potatoes roll down the swivel chute into the drum (mouth up +60°).
2/9 Wash: the lance of the tool arm sprays 1.5 L, the drum tumbles at 45 rpm, then pours about its lip into the drain gutter.
3/9 Peel in rumbler mode: knurled peel disc on the drum floor, tool arm holds the scraper in the charge, 120 rpm, 3 min.
4/9 The drum tilts about its fixed lower lip (x 590, z 1180) and pours the peeled potatoes into the pot on the raised deck.
5/9 Vessel shuttle: the head grips the pot's tang, the deck drops away, the pot goes onto hob R1 (3 kW) to boil.
6/9 Cucumber slides onto the belt; G2 holds it, the belt advances one slice per stroke, guillotine G1 cuts, slices drop into the bowl.
7/9 The head carries the bowl to R3, the hand-over port to serving (the cucumber end went to the tail chute).
8/9 Self-wash: lance, tumble, pour to the gutter. The belt runs through its wash box; the nose extends once so the rails get wet.
9/9 The drum's own coil heats the empty drum to 110 °C for 60 s: dry and disinfected. 6 L, 9 min per full wash.
